items.title: Emerging market central banks turn hawkish as inflation pressures mount, Citi says
items.summary: Investing.com - Emerging market central banks are pivoting toward a more hawkish stance to combat rising core inflation and sustained high energy costs, setting the stage for diverging local bond market returns next year, according to a research report from Citi.

items.title: Citi explains why the AI trade may remain under pressure
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi told clients in a note on Friday that the AI trade could remain under pressure after the U.S. midterm elections, and it prefers European stocks over U.S. equities for now.
